landing.headline: Resolve IT issues faster. Give your team room to breathe.
landing.subhead: An AI support agent that diagnoses, proposes, and resolves device issues — with human approval for every meaningful change.
landing.sectionTitle: From the first signal to a verified resolution
landing.feature1Body: Correlate device health, services, and ticket history to identify the real cause.
landing.feature2Body: System-changing actions always pass through policy and a clear approval step.
landing.feature3Body: The platform does not just run commands — it checks the result before closing a ticket.
landing.howTitle: AI handles the repetitive work. Technicians handle what matters.
landing.step1Body: Device telemetry creates a signal as soon as something looks wrong.
landing.step2Body: AI uses read-only tools to narrow down the root cause.
landing.step3Body: A technician approves the action; a separated agent executes it.
landing.step4Body: The result is checked and recorded in the audit trail.
landing.safetyTitle: Automation should never mean losing control.
landing.safetyBody: Tenant kill switches, risk tiers, per-action approvals, and a complete audit trail keep your team in charge of every AI decision.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take the pressure off IT?
landing.ctaBody: Start with repetitive tickets and expand automation at your own pace.
landing.footer: AI IT Support — intelligent operations, clear control.
